list as *ESP32 Agent*. It keeps the H.264 stream (no decoding on the board) and for"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"wards it to the app over Wi-Fi
(TCP, port 7201). BLE carries commands and status. The phone keeps us"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ing cellular data for the model while it is
on the board's hotspot.
- **Hands — USB HID.** The board"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" is a standard USB mouse and keyboard. With AssistiveTouch on, the mouse moves an
on-screen pointer,"},{"id":"p26s6","text":" so a click is a tap and a drag is a swipe.
- **Brain — the app.** The app decodes the stream, sends"},{"id":"p26s7","text":" screenshots to any OpenAI-compatible vision model, and runs
a planner and an actor: tap, swipe, dra"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"w, type, press keys, go home, finish. It runs in the background while it
works; the Dynamic Island s"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"hows what it is doing.
- **Closing the loop.** The pointer is relative, so the app tracks it and re-"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"homes it in a corner; before precise taps
it wiggles the pointer, finds it on screen and corrects th"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"e miss. After each action it waits for the screen to
settle and tells the model whether anything cha"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"nged. A lost board, hotspot or mirroring link pauses the run and
resumes it from the same step.
- **"},{"id":"p26s13","text":"Review.** Every run is kept on the phone: replay it step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on t"},{"id":"p26s14","text":"op.
